subject: PO requirements, monthly invoice sweep & net60 exception
messages:
From: Amelia Cho <purchasing@calyxhealth.com>

Cc: Tom Reed <treed@calyxhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PO format + monthly invoice sweep & net60 exception

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the conversation earlier. Our AP team has a few requirements we need to confirm before we can issue a PO and set up payments for the pilot: 

- We need a single monthly consolidated invoice for the contract (one invoice per calendar month, covering all seats and usage).
- Net60 payment terms are required by our finance policy for vendors of this size.
- PO must include: PO number, cost center, GL code, and the vendor remit-to email.
- Invoice file format: PDF with line-item breakdown and access to an emailed CSV summary on request.

Attached are our PO template and a short special-terms sheet the legal team asked to include. Can Redwood accept the monthly sweep + net60, and will you be able to map charges to our GL codes? Also please send any packaging options or discounts for a 12-month committed term (we're evaluating committed vs. quarterly).

If feasible, please confirm the exact PO fields we should populate. Our goal is to get a PO to you next week.

Best,
Amelia Cho
Senior Procurement Specialist
Calyx Health
Attachment: Calyx_PO_template_v2.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Special_Terms_Sheet.docx (docx)

Hi Amelia — thanks for the clear checklist and the templates. Appreciate the detail. Short answers up front: we can generate one consolidated PDF invoice per calendar month and include a line-item CSV on request; we can accept a PO; net60 is not our standard (we default to net30) but we can route a net60 exception to Finance for approval under certain commercial conditions.

Ben — can you propose commercial options for a 12-month committed package (pricing and discount tiers) and confirm whether a one-time onboarding credit would help bridge the net-term gap?

Priyom — can you confirm what Finance needs to approve net60 for an enterprise customer (credit checks, MSA, additional billing contacts, etc.) and whether we can accept the Calyx PO template as-is or need formatting changes?

Amelia/Tom — I'll follow up with concrete options and any required paperwork (MSA addendum/Exhibit A) by tomorrow.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Commercial options for Calyx — pricing + onboarding credit

Vanessa / Priyom,

Thanks — summarized below are two pragmatic options I think will be attractive to Calyx and acceptable to Finance with minimal change controls: 

1) Annual committed (preferred)
- 12-month commitment, invoiced monthly (consolidated invoice per month)
- 10% volume discount applied to subscription fees
- Standard net30, but we can grant net60 on final approval; require signed MSA and customer credit check before start
- One-time onboarding credit: $5,000 applied to first invoice (to offset payment timing concerns)

2) Net60 concession option
- 12-month commitment on contract pricing, invoice monthly consolidated
- 6% discount (lower because of receivable risk)
- Net60 accepted if Finance signs off; require PO up front and an approved credit hold process

Suggested PO wording (to help AP fill fields):
- "Please include PO Number, Cost Center, GL Code, and Redwood remit-to: billing@redwoodinference.com"
- "Invoice cadence: one consolidated PDF invoice per calendar month; CSV summary available on request"

I've attached a short spreadsheet with the numbers and an example invoice layout. Priyom — can you confirm the documentation required to approve option #2 (credit check threshold, MSA evidence, AR hold mechanics)? If we can get Finance to agree to option #2, I think Calyx will sign quickly.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Commercial_Scenarios.xlsx

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial options for Calyx — pricing + onboarding credit

Ben / Vanessa,

Finance can approve net60 for enterprise customers under these controls: 
- Signed MSA (or MSA + Exhibit A) on file before first invoice.
- Completed customer credit check with acceptable risk score; if score is below threshold we require a payment guarantee or prepay.
- PO must include PO number, cost center, GL code, and vendor remit-to email; format in the Calyx template is fine but the PO number field must be populated.
- We require a billing contact and an escalation path for failed payments; emails should be included on the PO.

Monthly consolidated invoice on the last business day is acceptable. For option #2 (net60 concession) we will require a signed credit exception form and mark the account with an AR watch flag — this will delay provisioning by one business day for final verification.

If Ben can lock the 6% concession + $5k onboarding credit, I think we can accept option #2 and mark the account Active pending MSA + PO + credit check. Please ensure the DocuSign envelope includes Exhibit A with billing terms and the credit exception fields.

— Priyom Das
Finance Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Amelia / Tom,

Thanks for the template and for outlining the PO requirements. We can move forward under the following commercial plan tailored to Calyx: 

- Agreed billing: one consolidated PDF invoice per calendar month (CSV summary available on request), delivered on the last business day.
- PO requirements: PO number, cost center, GL code, vendor remit-to (billing@redwoodinference.com). Please populate those fields in your template; Calyx's format is compatible.
- Net terms: We can accept net60 as a concession under option #2 below, contingent on signed MSA + Exhibit A and a completed credit check. Provisioning will occur after final verification.

Commercial options (pick one):
A) Annual committed — 12 months, 10% discount, net30 (preferred); $5k onboarding credit available.
B) Net60 concession — 12 months, 6% discount, net60 accepted with approved credit exception and AR watch flag.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm which option you prefer.
2) Complete and return the populated PO (PO number, cost center, GL code, billing contact).
3) We will send a DocuSign envelope with the MSA + Exhibit A (billing & credit exception language) — link: https://docusign.com/envelope/0A3F9B

If you confirm option B I will mark the request as "credit exception" and loop Priyom for the final credit check. If you pick A we can accelerate provisioning and apply the onboarding credit to the first invoice.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you prefer to walk through the PO fields.

Best,
